help.title: Timeline editor help
help.s1.title: Playback
help.s1.items:
Space — Play / pause the song
♪ button — Play only the synthesized notes, without the song (to check the melody)
Ruler (click or drag) — Move the playhead; the red line itself can be dragged too
Follow — The view scrolls along with the playhead while playing (you can turn it off)
Music / Notes — Volume sliders; click the name to mute, click again to get the volume back
help.s2.title: Notes
help.s2.items:
Click a note — Select it (you hear its tone)
Drag a note — Move it in time and pitch
Drag left / right edge — Change where it starts / how long it is
+ button, then click the roll — Add a note
S — Split the note in two
Del / Backspace — Delete the selected notes
help.s3.title: Selecting several
help.s3.items:
Drag on empty area — Rubber-band selection
Shift / Ctrl + click — Add or remove a note from the selection
Drag one of them — The whole group moves together
Ctrl + A / Esc — Select everything / nothing
help.s4.title: Copy, paste and undo
help.s4.items:
Ctrl + C / Ctrl + X — Copy / cut the selected notes
Ctrl + V — Paste at the playhead, keeping pitch and spacing
Ctrl + Z / Ctrl + Y — Undo / redo (a whole drag is one step)
help.s5.title: Phrases and note types
help.s5.items:
L / ¶ New phrase — This note starts a new line of lyrics
B / ⏎ Phrase end — The phrase ends here and an instrumental part follows: the break is exported right after this note
G — Golden note on / off
F — Freestyle note on / off (drawn, never scored)
Type menu — Normal, golden, freestyle, rap, golden rap
help.s6.title: View
help.s6.items:
Zoom / V-zoom — Horizontal (time) and vertical (row height) zoom
Video thumbnail — Drag it anywhere; double-click puts it back; the camera button hides it
help.s7.title: Microphone
help.s7.items:
Mic — Turn the microphone on, then sing along while the song plays
Sens / octave — Noise threshold and octave shift of what the microphone hears
Apply — Sets each note's pitch from what you sang
help.s8.title: Saving and exporting
help.s8.items:
Save — Saves the draft (it is also saved automatically while you work)
Export — Generates the Ultrastar .txt and its files
